GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 600m when racing keenly had to be steadied off heels. Approaching the 100m was inconvenienced by another runner. When questioned regarding the performance of the gelding, rider advised that his mount over-raced in the early and middle stages which combined with the gelding being first up following a spell, resulted in the gelding being unable to finish off its race. A post-race veterinary examination of the gelding did not reveal any abnormality.
